apollo_rule.MANDATORY: This section defines the single source of truth architecture for ALL Apollo development.

data_flow.php_array_object: Source of truth â€” all data originates from PHP backend
data_flow.rendered_html: Only user-facing content â€” never stores truth in DOM
data_flow.data_attributes: Only interaction hooks (data-a-*) â€” never hidden DOM truth
data_flow.debug_helper: Server log or admin-only debug panel â€” never client-side in production
data_flow.production: No debug output, no helper attributes, no console.log
data_flow.secure_db_data: Injected only in PHP before render, never as hidden DOM truth

mandatory_architecture: apollo_get_profile_context($user_id) â€” single source of truth for profile data
Render profile from that array â€” no scattered inline DB reads
Optionally pass a minimal JS config with wp_json_encode()
Keep helper tooltip/debug matching in WP_DEBUG only

audit_verificator.description: 12-point security and architecture audit checklist â€” run on every commit

checks.fix: Wrap with esc_html(), esc_attr(), esc_url(), wp_kses_post()
Move nonces/tokens to wp_json_encode() JS config block
Always use $wpdb->prepare() for any variable interpolation

checks.check: Debug output in production (console.log, error_log without WP_DEBUG)
checks.fix: Guard with if (WP_DEBUG) or remove entirely

checks.check: JS config exposing admin data to non-admins
checks.fix: Conditional: include admin keys only when current_user_can('manage_options')

checks.check: ABSPATH guard on every PHP file
File uploads: type validation + size limits
Sanitize ALL input at system boundaries

checks.fix: Throttle via apollo-login RateLimiter or per-endpoint logic

development_guidelines.hooks: apollo/{plugin}/{action} pattern â€” never legacy underscored hooks in new code
development_guidelines.rest: All under apollo/v1 â€” check registry for exact endpoint definitions
development_guidelines.templates: Canvas (uses wp_head/wp_footer) vs Blank Canvas (zero theme â€” apollo-login pattern)
development_guidelines.cdn: MANDATORY: load APOLLO_CDN_URL on every frontend template
